title: RetrievalResult
description: Results the caller may see, each cited, and which sources were consulted.

provenance.description: Knowledge entries only; documents carry their source's own metadata.

sourcesUnavailable.description: Sources whose authorisation failed; their documents were withheld, never returned unchecked.

testConnectors.description: Sources served by the in-memory test connector, not a real system.

packsOutsideAgentScope.description: Requested packs that the acting agent's template does not include (mandatory packs are never outside it). Nothing from them was searched or returned.

packsUnavailable.description: Packs of the acting agent's template that this knowledge service does not hold, so could not be searched.

delegation.title: RetrievalDelegation
delegation.description: Entra callers only: whether retrieval ran as the person's own agent. Without a delegation only the caller's personal layer and mandatory packs are searched, and every source is reported unavailable.

agent.description: The acting agent instance, when issued.

reason.title: RetrievalDelegationReason
reason.description: Why there is no delegation: the control plane's refusal reason, or unavailable when it could not be asked.
